dedupe_keys.name: flex household behaviour energy system operation and energy community model

description: FLEX is a modelling suite for household energy behaviour, household energy system operation and energy communities, developed by Fraunhofer ISI and the TU Wien Energy Economics Group in the Horizon 2020 newTRENDs project. FLEX-Behavior models each household member's activity at 10-minute resolution with a Markov chain and converts it into appliance electricity, hot water and occupancy profiles aggregated hourly. FLEX-Operation adds the building envelope and technologies such as the heating system, PV, thermal and battery storage and electric vehicles, and computes hourly operation, consumption and cost, either as a simulation or as an optimisation that minimises cost to represent a smart energy management system. FLEX-Community takes a group of households and models an aggregator that enables peer-to-peer trading and optimises battery operation. Coverage: generic households; the archived version was used for a study of variable electricity prices and heat pump buildings. Access: source on GitHub and version 0.1.1 archived on Zenodo on 2022-11-15. Licence: MIT; free. Caveats: the optimisation mode needs a solver through Pyomo and the authors suggest the commercial Gurobi; later development after that release was not checked. Simulation uses are household demand flexibility, heat pump operation under price signals and community-level load studies. Related records: the ResStock record for stock-level residential simulation.
